prerequisites: Input fixture is a previously executed 16-source Geo collection run, with no offerings.
Traveler Liyue main completion is explicitly injected only before final offering and Zibai checks: FLAG_TRV_LIYUE_CLEAR=true plus Q_TRV_LIYUE_04 claimed=true.
No runtime methods are modified. Movement encounter roll is suppressed on the test instance while using public MOVE actions.
Two Anemo points are collected through actual WORLD_WORK_START/FINISH actions to test currency separation.

results.name: actual Geo collection fixture loads with all 16 sources and independent empty Anemo ledger
two real Anemo collections leave Geo currency and receipts unchanged
GEO_TIER_1 consumes exact cost, grants exact reward, rejects duplicate and restores save
GEO_TIER_2 consumes exact cost, grants exact reward, rejects duplicate and restores save
final 7-token offering is gated by main completion then joins Zhongli without auto-party
Anemo offering consumes only Anemo tokens after all Geo offerings
Zibai return requires main completion, correct location and a free phase
Zibai return step 0 rejects out-of-order input and resumes exactly after reload
Zibai return step 1 rejects out-of-order input and resumes exactly after reload
Zibai return step 2 rejects out-of-order input and resumes exactly after reload
Zibai completed return cannot replay; full save restores contacts and both oculus ledgers
Zibai provenance and malformed progression imports reject with SIDE_STORY_SAVE
